en: \[VSCode] Fixed `/ide` in a second Claude Code session silently losing the editor connection back to the first session; the newest connection now wins and the displaced session shows how to switch back
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在第二个 Claude Code session 中执行 `/ide` 时，编辑器连接被静默切回第一个 session 的问题；现在最新的连接生效，被替换的 session 会提示如何切回
